messages:
Maya (Eng Reliability): Thanks everyone — quick thread for all-hands followups on today's reliability update. I'll drop RCAs + action items, please ack and own where appropriate.

Sam (CEO): Thanks Maya. Can you link the RCA docs?

Maya (Eng Reliability): RCA for the incident is here: https://redwood.internal/rca/inc-2026-04-02 :link: (public summary in confluence: https://confluence.redwood/team/reliability/inc-2026-04-02-summary)

Devon (Infra): @Maya @Erin I'll pick up the autoscaler tuning item. Will create JIRA and ping when done. :thumbsup: 

Priya (Product): Can someone confirm which customers were impacted? We need a brief for legal/comms.

Maya (Eng Reliability): Impact window and customer list added to the RCA. Short summary: ~8 customers saw 5-20s latency spikes for 12m. cc @Sam

Erin (SRE): Putting the action list here so it's easy to track. Will own rolling deploy checklist.

Erin (SRE): ```
Actions (owner - ETA)
- Autoscaler tuning (Devon) - 2026-04-09
- Rolling deploy playbook (Erin) - 2026-04-06
- Alert thresholds & runbook updates (Jesse) - 2026-04-05
- Postmortem follow-up evals (Maya) - 2026-04-08
```

Jesse (Eng): I'll take the alerts item. Do we want to lower the error-rate alarm or add a separate latency SLI alert?

Erin (SRE): Add separate latency SLI alert first, then refine. I can draft the alert change and share in #eng-sre for review.

Sam (CEO): Good plan. Make sure the rollout plan includes a fallback to smaller model variants by region.

Maya (Eng Reliability): Note: ops-runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rolling-deploys. Added canary thresholds in the document.

rca-bot: RCA doc updated by Maya (Eng Reliability) — https://redwood.internal/rca/inc-2026-04-02 — 1912345705

Priya (Product): Can we get a short owner-facing timeline for comms to customers? Legal wants a 48h estimate.

Maya (Eng Reliability): I'll draft the comms brief and share here by EOD today. ETA: 2026-04-03 18:00 UTC. @Priya

Devon (Infra): Question: is the autoscaler regression from config drift or a code change?

Maya (Eng Reliability): Initial findings point to config drift in the bucket-sizing; more detail in RCA under 'root cause'.

Priya (Product): Thanks. Also, can we add a single tracking doc for all action items? Prefer a simple checklist instead of multiple JIRAs.

Erin (SRE): Created tracking doc: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/track-incident-actions — I added the checklist from above and JIRA column.

Jesse (Eng): FYI I'll post the alert patch in a PR tomorrow morning.

Maya (Eng Reliability): One more ask from all-hands: leadership asked for a short deck slide with 3 bullets: root cause, mitigations, next steps. I'll prepare and send to @Sam by EOD.

Sam (CEO): Appreciate it. Let's ensure follow-ups are visible in the reliability board for the next all-hands.

Maya (Eng Reliability): Noted. Scheduling a 30m sync for owners: https://calendar.redwood/event/12345 — 2026-04-04 15:00 UTC. Please RSVP.

Priya (Product): RSVP'd. :white_check_mark:

Devon (Infra): RSVP'd.

Erin (SRE): RSVP'd.

Maya (Eng Reliability): Thanks all — ping me directly if you hit blockers. I'll keep this thread updated with PRs and JIRA links.
